v01-man-lots-tomatoes.observed_description: An older man in a straw hat at a market stall holds a big box full of tomatoes.
v01-man-lots-tomatoes.note: He has a lot of tomatoes.

v02-girl-few-eggs.observed_description: A teenage girl with braids holds out an egg box with only a few eggs in it.

v03-boy-little-soup.observed_description: A boy looks into a bowl that still holds some soup at a kitchen table.
v03-boy-little-soup.note: REJECTED: the bowl does not clearly hold only a little soup; remade as v5152 v15.

v04-coffee-yes.observed_description: A young man with glasses hands a mug of coffee to an older woman on a sofa who takes it.
v04-coffee-yes.note: Would you like some coffee? Yes, please.

v05-both-like-cake.observed_description: Two young women at a cafe table both eat chocolate cake and smile happily.
v05-both-like-cake.note: They both like cake. / I like cake. So do I.

v06-wants-to-sleep.observed_description: A tired man in pajamas yawns and stretches by his bed in a bedroom.
v06-wants-to-sleep.note: He wants to go to bed.

v07-dishes-after-dinner.observed_description: A man washes plates at the kitchen sink; empty plates on the dining table behind him.
v07-dishes-after-dinner.note: He washes the plates after dinner.

v08-potatoes-6.observed_description: A sack of potatoes on a market counter behind a large $6 price card.
v08-potatoes-6.note: How much are the potatoes? They're six dollars.

v09-woman-orders-soup.observed_description: An older woman in a red cardigan at a cafe counter with a bowl of soup in front of her.

v10-mugs.observed_description: A white cup with a $5 card beside a red cup with a $15 card on a shop table.

v11-jacket-57.observed_description: A blue denim jacket on a hanger with a $57 price card in front of it.

v12-pizza-sandwich.observed_description: A sandwich cut in half showing boiled egg and yellow cheese inside.
v12-pizza-sandwich.note: There's egg and cheese in it.

v13-pass-salt.observed_description: An older man hands a salt shaker across a dinner table to his wife, who takes it.
v13-pass-salt.note: Can you pass the salt, please? Here you are.
